notes: A 1-minute chart left open goes stale the minute after it loads. This release lets it follow the tape — as a DELTA, and only when asked. - A Realtime checkbox joins Log and Ext on the workbench's bottom bar, enabled ONLY on the 1-minute interval (disabled elsewhere, with a tooltip saying why). It is OPT-IN and never the default: unchecked, today's behavior is exactly unchanged. When checked, once per minute the chart fetches ONLY the newest 1-minute bars and merges them into the loaded series — never a full-history refetch or repaint. - Merge semantics, by bar time.
